messages.content: Who won the most valuable player in last season's basketball game?

function.name: sports_ranking_get_team_ranking
function.description: Retrieve the ranking of a specific team in a particular sport league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport_league.description: The league that the team is in.

season.description: The season for which the ranking is requested. If not provided, the most recent season is considered. Default: 1

message.content:

Once I’ve got those details, I can give you the most accurate information available!

But we have no direct data; maybe use knowledge up to 2025. Last season would refer to 2022–23 or 2023–24 depending on current time. As of May 2026, last completed NBA season was 2025‑26? Actually NBA seasons end around June each year. In May 2026, next season hasn't finished yet. So "last season" likely refers to 2024‑25 season. Who got MVP? That might be Nikola Jokic again? He had back-to-back MVPs 2020 and 2021. For 2024‑25, I don't know. Could guess it's Giannis Antetokounmpo? Or Luka Doncic? Might be uncertain.

We could ask clarifying question about what league they mean. Also mention uncertainty. Use safe completion style. Provide best known info: For NBA 2024‑25, MVP winner unknown as of now. Alternatively if referring to college basketball? Not sure.
